name: Goyama Ashen Daimyo

phases.name: Scribe of Order
phases.on_break: Petitions scatter and reveal the child Krona's name under white-out. Sets Daimyo_Phase1.
phases.notes: Shield 3, plate [SHIELD 3 -> 2 (-1) -> BREAK!] [VIT?][???]. Weak throughout [VITREOUS][TACHYON]: glass reveals the true text beneath ink, a time needle rewinds the petitions to blank.

phases.name: The Ever-Burning Roof
phases.notes: Shield 3, Tags [FIRE][PAPER]. In this chapter the [VITREOUS] weakness is reached through the Prism Lantern on the castle wall: a TACHYON Needle fired through the lantern's stained smoke carries [VITREOUS] for that hit.

phases.name: Oil Mother
phases.notes: Shield 2. Oil floods the arena: Ash Field (slow + shield chip). Steals 1 BP every 10 s (Oil-Blight; a battle-time timer, the drain action is the stand-in).

phases.name: The Barren Seal
phases.on_break: The Daimyo's porcelain cracks to Lavos muscle fibre, the same as Crono's chest at 20%.
phases.notes: Shield 1, plate [SHIELD 1 -> BREAK!] [WEAK: VITREOUS + TACHYON DUAL]. Immune to everything except a single hit carrying both [VITREOUS] and [TACHYON] (the weak list cannot express 'both at once'; must be scripted). Boost lesson: Breaking him with a 3 BP Lv3 hit triggers the style bleed (watercolour afterimages, gold leaf flecks).

options.label: Repainted
options.requires: save the house three times, seal the vein; the Dojo opens and teaches Ens Parry +2 frames

options.label: Incinerated
options.requires: let it burn three times; the Nodachi gains +15% RUIN damage; U1 is locked to Crimson Night

options.label: Both
options.requires: seal the vein but keep a vial; Amber Rift

notes: Lv 10, HP 18,000. Krona's former pigment lord fused to Goyama castle's burning floors; a body of petition scrolls, 20 ft but always seated. Weak throughout [VITREOUS][TACHYON]. HP windows per phase are not given and are split evenly across the four phases. Loot: Cobalt Nodachi; the Vaelos Tooth relic (it whispers in the clean young Crono voice). Base tags inferred from 'a body of petition scrolls'.
